sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.
the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The only approval for SUP-C on BR-180 is for receiving plant PLT-BEI. The ASL has no approval for PLT-PIN, and the 2026-11-06 re-audit did not add part approvals. Delivery to Pinerolo is therefore not released.

sources.quote:
The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
after any of: a change of source
Approval is granted per part number and per manufacturing site.
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: BR-180 is on PRG-Z, a CUST-AUR program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual is in force and replaces revision 3. It ties approval to the part and the site, so the move to a different site needs written Aurelia approval (PPAP) and 90 days' notice. No approval or deviation covers it, and DEV-114 has expired.
